note.text: El Niño is an unusual warming of the sea surface in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean. note.text: By convention, Parliament meets in three sessions a year. The Budget Session usually begins in late January or early February and runs into April. note.text: By convention, Parliament meets in three sessions a year. The Budget Session usually begins in late January or early February and runs into April. The Monsoon Session usually falls in July and August. The Winter Session usually falls in November and December. What happens when Parliament is not in session and the government needs a law urgently? Article 123 lets the President issue an ordinance, on the advice of the Council of Ministers. An ordinance has the same force as an Act, but it is temporary. It must be laid before both Houses when they reassemble, and it ceases to operate 6 weeks after Parliament meets again, unless it is replaced by a law earlier.
